title: KIRSCH-PLATE: circular hole in a tension plate, K_t = 3 (Kirsch 1898)

reference.citation: Kirsch (1898) VDI 42, 797; Timoshenko & Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., Art. 39, eqs. (a)-(c)
reference.closed_form: sigma_tt(a, theta) = T (1 - 2 cos 2 theta); K_t = sigma_tt(a, pi/2)/T = 3
reference.basis: gross stress T (far-field tension); net basis K_tn = K_tg (1 - d/W)
reference.note: K_t = 3 is evaluated from the cited closed form and the oracle is self-checked (traction-free edge, uniaxial far field) inside oracle_selfcheck

model.geometry: quarter plate 0<=x<=L, 0<=y<=W/2, hole quadrant of radius a=d/2 at origin
model.boundary_conditions: u_x=0 on x=0; u_y=0 on y=0; hole edge and y=W/2 traction free; uniform tension T on x=L
model.element: Q4 plane stress, starburst mesh graded to the hole (production path)
model.crosscheck_element: Q8 serendipity plane stress, polar annulus, exact Kirsch displacement on r = R_out
